info.title: ZARI ERP API
info.description:
Complete API reference for the ZARI ERP backend (Express 5 + PostgreSQL + Drizzle ORM).

  **Authentication.** Most endpoints require a Bearer JWT obtained from `POST /api/auth/login` with seeded admin credentials `admin@zarierp.com` / `Admin@123`. Send the token in the `Authorization: Bearer <token>` header.

  **Base path.** All endpoints are served under `/api`. The platform reverse proxy listens on port 80 in development and `$REPLIT_DOMAINS` in production.

  Auto-generated from `artifacts/api-server/src/routes/` — 433 endpoints across 45 modules.

get.summary: Returns all client + vendor invoices enriched with payment summary

post.summary: Record payment on a vendor bill (legacy)

get.summary: Returns { referenceId: number, totalPaid: number }[] for all rows in an order
BOM rows: uses consumedQty (not requiredQty) + weighted avg price from PRs + HSN from master.
Combined reference list: active master styles + non-cancelled style orders
GET all artworks for a style order (optionally filtered by product)
List products for a style order

delete.summary: Delete (soft) — only Draft orders with no linked records

get.summary: LIST (all PRs from purchase_receipts — covers both Inventory and Costing sources)

put.summary: UPDATE Open PR items (edit quantities/prices before confirming)

post.summary: POST /api/settings/activity-logs/action — log client-side events (e.g. PDF downloads)

get.summary: GET /api/settings/activity-logs/users — list of users for admin filter

post.summary: POST /api/settings/download-logs — log a download (any authenticated user)

bearerAuth.description: JWT issued by `POST /api/auth/login`. Send as `Authorization: Bearer <token>`.
